question: How many Mandalas were in Rig Vedic Samhita?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rig Vedic Samhita** consists of **10 Mandalas**.
 
• These Mandalas are collections of hymns dedicated to various deities.
 
• The hymns are composed in Vedic Sanskrit and are among the oldest texts in any Indo-European language.
 
• The **Rig Veda** is one of the four canonical sacred texts (śruti) of Hinduism known as the Vedas.
 
• Each Mandala varies in length and content, with the second to the seventh Mandala being the oldest and most important.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rig Veda** is divided into ten books known as Mandalas.
 
• It is a collection of 1,028 hymns (sūktas) and 10,600 verses (mantras).
 
• The hymns are dedicated to various deities, primarily Agni, Indra, and Soma.
 
• The **Rig Veda** is one of the oldest extant texts in the world and is a key text in the study of ancient Indo-European languages and cultures.
 
• The **Rig Veda** provides crucial insights into the early Vedic civilization and its religious practices.
